نتفاجأ (form VI)
# نَتَفَاجَأُ (natafājaʔu) /na.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# نَتَفَاجَأَ (natafājaʔa) /na.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# نَتَفَاجَأْ (natafājaʔ) /na.ta.faː.d͡ʒaʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
